summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the escape-sequence formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated on is_terminal, next to show_cursor. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(control_code[1]). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Tests and Black were not run, per instructions; verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
